changelog: RUN DETAILS NOW OPENS. Settings has a Run details panel listing every modifier, ascension tier and Daily Commission exception together with what each one actually does — so a troop cap of 4 has an explanation instead of being a mystery. It threw outside a battle, which meant that on the expedition map the button did nothing but close the Settings window. AN EMPTY DAILY LEADERBOARD NOW SAYS SO. The standings drew nothing whether there was no board at all or a board nobody had posted to yet, so on the day the feature went live it was indistinguishable from the leaderboard not existing. It now tells you no scores have been set today and invites you to set the first.
